findings.title: Container allows privilege escalation
findings.description: allowPrivilegeEscalation: true lets a process gain more privileges than its parent, typically via setuid binaries. It should be false unless the workload genuinely needs it.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Bind minimal RBAC roles (no cluster-admin), scope ServiceAccounts per workload, and enable audit logging.

findings.title: Container without resource limits
findings.description: A container without resources.limits for cpu and memory can exhaust node resources (noisy neighbor / DoS). Set cpu and memory limits on every container.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Container without liveness probe
findings.description: A container without a livenessProbe is never restarted when it deadlocks, leaving a broken pod serving traffic. Define a liveness probe.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Container without readiness probe
findings.description: A container without a readinessProbe receives traffic before it is ready, causing failed requests during startup. Define a readiness probe.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Binding grants cluster-admin
findings.description: A RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding whose roleRef points at cluster-admin grants full cluster control to its subjects. Bind least-privilege roles instead and audit cluster-admin bindings.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Container without read-only root filesystem
findings.description: The container's effective readOnlyRootFilesystem is not true: either it is explicitly false, or it is unset at both the container and pod level, leaving the root filesystem writable at runtime and aiding persistence after compromise. Set readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and use volumes for writable paths. (AEGIS-K8S-005 covers the explicit-false case alone.)
findings.remediation: Require MFA / SSO for cluster access; never use the cluster-admin kubeconfig for daily operations. Bind users to least-privilege RBAC.

findings.title: Container without seccomp profile
findings.description: Neither the container nor the pod sets a seccompProfile with type RuntimeDefault or Localhost, so the container runs without seccomp syscall filtering. Set seccompProfile.type to RuntimeDefault. (AEGIS-K8S-017 covers the explicit Unconfined case alone.)
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Workload without a NetworkPolicy
findings.description: No NetworkPolicy in the workload's namespace selects its pods, so the pods accept traffic from anywhere in the cluster. Add a NetworkPolicy with a podSelector matching the workload's pod labels (default-deny ingress and egress, then allow what the workload needs).
findings.evidence: metadata.labels = no NetworkPolicy selects pods (namespace "default", labels app=shop-49f23d)
findings.expected: NetworkPolicy with podSelector matching this workload's pods
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Bind minimal RBAC roles (no cluster-admin), scope ServiceAccounts per workload, and enable audit logging.

findings.title: Container image without digest pin
findings.description: A container image without an @digest pin (e.g. image@sha256:...) can change under its tag: the tag may be moved to a different image. Pin images by digest for reproducible, verifiable deployments.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
